## History

Gertie Pye was a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). During Anne's absence from school, Gertie was among the classmates who offered to sit with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon her return, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) declined the offer. She later participated in the successful local evening concert alongside her fellow students.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII.
